raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Motivation

Since #42833, tokens-in gRPC clients can send images, video and audio. They cannot tell which of these the server reads. Without awareness of the mode's multimodal capability, the model can drop the media and hallucinates answers. The client then gets an answer to a prompt without the media.

## Modifications

- `GetServerInfo` adds `grpc_features`: `image_inputs`, `video_inputs` and `audio_inputs`, one per placeholder token that the model's processor has. A client sends a media kind only when the list has it.
- `BaseMultimodalProcessor.mm_tokens` defaults to `None`, so a processor without these tokens lists none. LLaVA 1.5 and Whisper are examples.
- Only the gRPC leader adds the list. HTTP and follower metadata do not change, and the server-info parity test now checks that.

## Accuracy Tests

`Qwen/Qwen3-VL-2B-Instruct` over gRPC, through a client that sends a media kind only when `grpc_features` lists it (Dynamo's SGLang sidecar):

| Request | without this PR | this PR |
|---|---|---|
| `grpc_features` | absent | `["image_inputs", "video_inputs"]` |
| image URL or `data:` URI | refused by the client | 200, 1041 prompt tokens |
| video URL | refused by the client | 200, 2297 prompt tokens |
| audio | refused by the client | refused by the client, no `audio_inputs` |

Unit tests: `test_grpc_bridge.py` and `test_server_info.py` 41 passed. On main, the new checks fail with `KeyError: 'grpc_features'`.

## Speed Tests and Profiling

N/A.

- [x] Add unit tests according to the [Run and add unit tests](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#run-and-add-unit-tests).
- [ ] Update documentation according to [Write documentations](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#write-documentations). (No user-facing docs change.)
- [x] Provide accuracy and speed benchmark results according to [Test the accuracy](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#test-the-accuracy) and [Benchmark the speed](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#benchmark-the-speed). (Speed: N/A.)
- [x] Follow the SGLang code style [guidance](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#code-style-guidance).

## Review and Merge Process

1. Ping Merge Oncalls to start the process. See the [PR Merge Process](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/blob/main/.github/MAINTAINER.md#pull-request-merge-process).
2. Get approvals from [CODEOWNERS](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/blob/main/.github/CODEOWNERS) and other reviewers.
3. Trigger CI tests with [comments](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#how-to-trigger-ci-tests) or contact authorized users to do so.
   - Common commands include `/tag-and-rerun-ci`, `/tag-run-ci-label`, `/rerun-failed-ci`
4. After green CI and required approvals, ask Merge Oncalls or people with Write permission to merge the PR.

+def _media_input_features(mm_processor) -> List[str]:
+    if mm_processor is None or mm_processor.mm_tokens is None:
+        return []
+    tokens = mm_processor.mm_tokens
+    return [
+        feature
+        for feature, token in (
+            ("image_inputs", tokens.image_token),
+            ("video_inputs", tokens.video_token),
+            ("audio_inputs", tokens.audio_token),
+        )
+        if token
+    ]
